description.zh:
实例ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~)接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL版实例的详情，包括实例ID。
description.en:
The instance ID.

>  You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~) operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances within a region, including instance IDs.

description.zh: 凭据的描述信息。长度不能超过255个字符。
description.en: The description of the access credential.
The password of the database account that is used to access the instance.
The region ID of the instance.

description.zh: 凭据名称。由字母、数字和下划线组成，长度为1-16个字符。为空时则使用Username参数作为SecretName。
description.en: The name of the access credential. The name must be 1 to 16 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, and underscores (\_). If you leave this parameter empty, the value of the Username parameter is used.

description.zh: 是否通过用户名和密码检测实例链接是否正常。
description.en: Specifies whether to check the connectivity to the instance by using the name and password of the database account.

description.zh:
数据库访问用户名。

> 限制：
> - 由小写字母，数字，下划线组成，并且以小写字母开头。
> - 长度不能超过64个字符。
description.en: The name of the database account that is used to access the instance.

description.zh: 多数据库实例组成的Workspace的Id。此参数和DBInstanceId参数不能同时为空，当和DBInstanceId同时指定时以此参数为准。
description.en: The ID of the workspace that consists of multiple AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances. You must specify one of the WorkspaceId and DBInstanceId parameters. If you specify both parameters, the WorkspaceId parameter takes precedence.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb create-secret --db-instance-id gp-xxxxxxxxx --workspace-id gp-ws-00000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --username testacc --password pwd123 --description test --secret-name testsecret --test-connection true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun gpdb CreateSecret --region cn-hangzhou --SecretName testsecret --Description test --DBInstanceId 'gp-xxxxxxxxx' --Username testacc --WorkspaceId 'gp-ws-00000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --TestConnection true --Password pwd123
